name: dax
description: The DAX language, agent-native. Every built-in function with its signature, return type, where it is legal (measure, calculated column, calculated table, visual calculation, query) and the gotchas the docs leave out; the conceptual pages behind them (evaluation context, context transition, EVALUATE/DEFINE, operators, BLANK semantics, VAR); the daxlib.org catalogue to check before writing a UDF; how to author a FUNCTION correctly; and the window family in depth. Derived from MicrosoftDocs/query-docs and annotated with field notes measured against a real model. Not performance tuning - that is data-goblin's dax skill.
